C1078.title: Credit Card Fraud via Fake Free Mall Wi-Fi
C1078.summary: On November 10, 2024, a shopper named Li connected to an unsecured free Wi-Fi network in a shopping mall. Shortly after making a mobile banking payment, multiple SMS alerts indicated four unauthorized credit card transactions totaling 5,300 yuan. Police warned the network was likely a rogue access point set up by criminals to intercept private data and payment credentials.

references.title: Jiangsu Provincial Public Security Department Prevention Tips: Beware! Free Wi-Fi can also become a 'thief'!
